title: sf-metascope report document
description: A report document: the structure of a report (components, their order, and the kinds of data to show). It does not name individual classes or objects; use for / where to take them from data rows. Build it with sf-metascope report build or the MCP tool build_report.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema of documents (for editors). The build ignores it.

diff.description: true compares the saved baseline with the working tree (rows get status). Omit for a report of the current state (everything, no status).

compare.description: Two points of git to compare (e.g. { "from": "main" } for main...working tree). Takes precedence over diff.

from.description: Base revision (branch, tag or commit), e.g. main or origin/main.

to.description: Target revision. Omit (or WORKTREE) for the working tree.

mergeBase.description: true (default) compares from the point where to branched off from (like main...HEAD). false compares from itself.

withSource.description: true adds a source excerpt (_source) to each row that has a position (for DataTable showSource).
